messages:
Alex (Sales): Hey team—Acme needs a quick POC token for the Hosted API sandbox. Goal: short-lived guest token, IP allowlist, scoped to generation + streaming. Can someone provision and document rotation/revoke steps?
Mira (Solutions): Yep. Recommended flow: create a dedicated POC project, generate a short-lived API token (TTL 48h or 7d depending on their preference), apply customer CIDR allowlist, enable audit logging. I can do console or CLI.
Sam (Eng-Infra): CLI snippet if useful:
```
redwoodctl tokens create --project poc-acme --scopes generate,streaming --ttl 48h --name "guest-poc-acme"
```
It prints the secret once — stash it in their vault or send via secure channel.
Taylor (Security): Security checklist: scope to minimal permissions, TTL <= 7d for POCs, require IP allowlist (customer CIDR), and enable token-use alerts. If they need longer then use KMS-backed keys and restrict to a dedicated project.
Jordan (Acme): Can we automate rotation every 48h without downtime? Also want the ability to revoke immediately if needed.
Mira (Solutions): Yes — we support rolling rotation: create the new token, update env, then revoke old token. We also have a key-rotation endpoint if you want an automated job. We'll provide a small script.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Revocation options:
```
# revoke by id via CLI
redwoodctl tokens revoke --token-id tok_abc123

# revoke via API (admin key)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/tokens/revoke" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"token_id":"tok_abc123"}'
```
DeployBot: audit_log: token_create event token_id=tok_xyz user=Mira (Solutions) project=poc-acme ts=1718801242, stored at /console/logs?project=poc-acme
Mira (Solutions): For the POC I'll provision: project=poc-acme, scopes=generate,streaming, ttl=48h, allowlist=198.51.100.0/24. I'll DM the one-time token to Jordan's SRE and paste rotation script.
Alex (Sales): Jordan — confirming CIDR + whether you need streaming (yes per earlier). Also confirm who we should DM the token to (email or SRE Slack handle).
Jordan (Acme): CIDR: 198.51.100.0/24. Streaming yes. Please DM to ops@acme.example and include rotation script.
Taylor (Security): Also enable alerts: failed_auth >5/min from unique IPs and token-use metric on the project dashboard. Add requirement: if token is used outside allowlist, auto-revoke.
Mira (Solutions): Will enable alerts and the auto-revoke policy for that token. Rotation script (example) included below for their SRE: 
```
#!/bin/bash
# rotate-token.sh - simple 48h rotation
ADMIN_KEY="$ADMIN_KEY"
PROJECT="poc-acme"
# create new token
NEW_JSON=$(curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/tokens" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"project":"poc-acme","scopes":["generate","streaming"],"ttl":"48h","name":"guest-poc-acme-rot"}')
NEW_TOKEN=$(echo "$NEW_JSON" | jq -r .secret)
# deploy NEW_TOKEN to env (customer-specific step)
# after validation, revoke old token by id
# curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/tokens/revoke" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" -d '{"token_id":"<old_token_id>"}'
```
Alex (Sales): Perfect. Mira — proceed to provision and share DM. Ping me once done and I'll follow up on billing/usage limits for the POC. :thumbsup:
Mira (Solutions): Provisioned and DM sent to ops@acme.example. Token TTL=48h, allowlist set, alerts enabled. I'll attach the rotation script to the ops email. :lock:
